definitions.explanation: A formal organization or association established to promote or regulate a particular activity, profession, or cause. Often appears in the names of professional bodies and industry groups.

examples.japanese: サッカー{協会|きょうかい}に{登録|とうろく}した。
examples.english: I registered with the football association.

examples.japanese: {日本|にほん}{相撲|すもう}{協会|きょうかい}が{新|あたら}しいルールを{発表|はっぴょう}した。
examples.english: The Japan Sumo Association announced new rules.

examples.japanese: {国際|こくさい}{協会|きょうかい}の{代表者|だいひょうしゃ}が{会議|かいぎ}に{出席|しゅっせき}し、{各国|かっこく}の{意見|いけん}をまとめた。
examples.english: Representatives of the international association attended the conference and compiled the opinions of each country.

notes:
{協会|きょうかい} refers to a formally organized body that promotes, regulates, or oversees a specific field. It commonly appears as a suffix attached to the name of the field or activity.

WATCH OUT:
Not to be confused with {教会|きょうかい} (church), which uses different kanji.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ～{協会|きょうかい}: ~ association (used as suffix)
- {協会|きょうかい}に{加盟|かめい}する: to join an association
- {協会|きょうかい}の{会員|かいいん}: member of an association
- {観光|かんこう}{協会|きょうかい}: tourism association
- {日本|にほん}～{協会|きょうかい}: Japan ~ Association

EXAMPLES IN USE:
- {日本|にほん}{相撲|すもう}{協会|きょうかい}: Japan Sumo Association
- {日本|にほん}サッカー{協会|きょうかい}: Japan Football Association
- {国際|こくさい}{交流|こうりゅう}{協会|きょうかい}: international exchange association
